{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"0000000000000CXEMXECE75QBQ","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram flow=down
group app "Composer (client)" {
  node Companion "Discord companion" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-discord/src/containers/DiscordAgentSetup/DiscordAgentSetup.tsx"
  node Configure "ConfigureBackIndex" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-discord/src/operations/configure-back-index.ts"
}
group space "ECHO space" {
  node Trigger "Trigger (timer)" ref="packages/core/compute/compute/src/types/Trigger.ts"
  node State "CrawlState" ref="packages/core/compute/crawler/src/CrawlState.ts"
  node Facts "Fact feed" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-agent/src/FactFeed.ts"
  node Topics "Topics, Persons" ref="packages/core/compute/pipeline-discord/src/types/Topic.ts"
}
group cloud "EDGE" {
  node Compute "compute-service"
  node Host "Kai bot host"
  node Token "Kai token secret"
}
node Discord "Discord API"
edge Companion -> Configure "Index toggle"
edge Companion -> Host "bind: claims owner"
edge Configure -> Trigger "creates"
edge Configure -> State
edge Configure -> Facts
edge Trigger -> Compute "runs crawl"
edge Compute -> Host "fetchMessages"
edge Token -> Host "signs"
edge Host -> Discord "GET as Kai"
edge Compute -> State "cursors"
edge Compute -> Facts "facts"
edge Compute -> Topics "topics"
"},"objects":[
